canonicalIngredients.name: chicken thigh fillets
observations: 500 g boneless thigh or breast, 1 inch pieces (s2)

canonicalIngredients.name: kashmiri chilli powder
observations: 1/2-3/4 tsp + 1-2 tsp kashmiri or paprika, reduce for kids (s2)

canonicalIngredients.name: canned crushed tomatoes
observations: 15 oz can tomato sauce/passata + 1/4 cup water (s1)

canonicalIngredients.name: dried fenugreek leaves
observations: 1 tsp marinade + 1 tbsp sauce, kasuri methi (s2)

canonicalIngredients.name: whole spices
observations: cinnamon piece, 2-4 cardamom, 2-4 cloves, all optional (s2)

causalSequence: mix yoghurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, ground spices; coat chicken
sear or grill chicken over high heat until charred, just cooked; set aside
melt butter with oil; soften onion, garlic, ginger; add whole spices then bloom ground spices
add tomatoes, cashews, water; simmer 10-20 min
blend sauce completely smooth; return to pan
stir in cream, sugar, kasuri methi; add chicken, simmer 5 min
serve over steamed basmati rice, garnish coriander
techniqueFacts: all three marinate in spiced yoghurt; thick/greek yoghurt clings, runny yoghurt bleeds marinade off (1 source)
two sources hold high-heat char on the chicken as the depth lever (tandoor stand-in); one skips char for a pan-fry weeknight form
cashews blended into the tomato base give body without long reduction (2 sources); cream-only is the nut-free path
kasuri methi stirred in at the end is the signature finishing flavour (2 sources)
sugar balances tomato acidity (2 sources); onion also cuts acidity (1 source)
mild dish by design; kashmiri chilli is colour not heat, paprika sub keeps it kid-mild (2 sources)
no gluten ingredients; only risk is anti-caking agents in packet spice blends (1 source flags certified GF garam masala)
sauce keeps 3-5 days, improves overnight, freezes 3 months (2 sources)
